title: Pure Dual Avatar
summary: Dual Avatar cards only, with generic staples. Dual Avatar destroys its own monsters to fuel the next play. Dual Avatar Fists - Yuhi destroys a Dual Avatar to search a Dual Avatar Spell, and Dual Avatar Feet - Kokoku searches a Dual Avatar Trap. Dual Avatar Invitation fills the field with Spirit Tokens and Fusion Summons twice. Once a Fusion was made with an Effect Monster as material, the Empowered Fusions negate and remove cards on either turn. Perfect Sync - A-Un searches a Dual Avatar monster and makes another Token every turn. Dual Avatar Ascendance destroys one Dual Avatar to summon the one a Level above or below it from the Deck or Extra Deck. Dual Avatar - Manifested A-Un, the newest card, takes on the effects of the Empowered Fusions used as its material. Invitation and A-Un limit the Extra Deck to Fusions, so the Extra Deck is all Dual Avatar.
